items.title: Transit · Haneda → Shinjuku → Matsumoto (Ltd Exp Azusa 13)
items.how:
Airport Limousine bus T2 → Shinjuku Sta West Exit (Keiō Dept Store), ¥1,400 pp, 07:45 → 08:20 timetabled (allow 60–70 min on a Monday morning). The bus starts at T3 and calls at T2 10 min later
Ltd Exp Azusa 13: Shinjuku 10:00 → Matsumoto 12:37 (reserved seats, ~¥6,700 pp). Booked on the later train so Monday traffic can't make you miss it
items.notes:
05:55 Land at T2
06:00–07:00 Immigration, bags, customs
07:00–07:35 Seven Bank ATM for ¥ (T2 2F Welcome Center, 06:00–23:00), toilets; then down to 1F for bus tickets (Limousine ticket machines / counter) and the bus stop outside
07:45 Bus from T2 (take the 07:25 if out early); bags go under the bus
08:20–08:55 Shinjuku West Exit (08:20 timetabled; later in Monday traffic); 5–10 min walk to the JR gates
At Shinjuku by ~08:35: change to Azusa 9 (09:00 → 11:39) at a reserved-seat machine (one free change, if seats remain)
Otherwise: print the Azusa 13 tickets (QR from the booking), sit down for coffee or breakfast near the gates, on the platform by 09:50
10:00 Depart
12:37 Matsumoto; 5 min walk to Dormy Inn
Out by ~06:45: 06:55 bus, try to change to Azusa 5 (08:00 → 10:37)
If you land at T3 instead: same buses 10 min earlier (06:45 / 07:15 / 07:35 / 08:05); Seven Bank ATM and Limousine counter are in the T3 arrivals hall, 2F; the plan holds
Rail alt (~¥540 pp): Keikyū from Haneda T1·T2 Sta → Shinagawa → JR Yamanote Line → Shinjuku, ~45 min, but Monday rush hour with suitcases
Taxi alt: fixed fare ~¥9,000 + tolls per car to Shinjuku

Souvenir sweets: Kaiundō Honten, 2-2-15 Chūō on Honmachi-dōri next to Nakamachi (09:00–18:00, closed only 1 Jan; 'Hakuchō no Mizuumi'; small tea room inside)

items.title: Stroll · Omotesandō and Cat Street
items.how: Omotesandō avenue, Cat Street (Jingūmae)
items.notes:
Easy, flat shopping street. Café: BREAD, ESPRESSO & (3-4-9 Jingūmae, Tabelog 3.60; the mou toast; until 19:00, irregular holidays). Alt: Aoyama Flower Market GREEN HOUSE (tea inside the flower shop, open daily). Then on to Shibuya for Yuji
If wet: Omotesandō Hills instead (indoor, same avenue)

items.title: Optional · Jingū Gaien ginkgo avenue (only with the 18:00 Yuji seating)
items.how:
Jingū Gaien Ichō Namiki, Kita-Aoyama 1-chōme, Minato-ku, Tokyo; Ginza Line Omotesandō → Gaien-mae (1 stop), then ~5 min walk
Then to Shibuya: Ginza Line Gaien-mae → Shibuya, ~5 min
items.notes: ~300 m avenue of ginkgo trees, flat, free, open any time. Weathernews 2026 forecast: best from ~29 Nov, so on 19 Nov expect it only partly yellow. Skip if Yuji is the 16:00 seating

items.title: Dinner · Splurge ②: Sumibiyaki Yuji (wagyu yakiniku)
items.how:
Matsunuma Bldg 1F, 11-1 Udagawa-chō, Shibuya; ~8 min walk from Shibuya Sta
Back: JR Yamanote Line Shibuya → Shinagawa, then Tōkaidō Line → Kawasaki, ~35 min
items.notes: Tabelog 4.19 + Tabelog Award Bronze, the trip's crown jewel; ~¥8–10k pp, cash only. Slots go months out. Closed Sun and holidays; seatings 16:00 and 18:00. If skipping the splurge: Hikiniku to Come (Tabelog 3.70, charcoal wagyu-blend hamburg; web booking opens on the 1st of the month, cashless)
items.action: ★ Reserve now: phone only, ☎ 03-3464-6448 after 15:00 JST (Mets front desk can call)

days.label: 20 Nov
days.sub: Day trip: Great Buddha, Hase-dera, Hachimangū, sunset

items.title: Day trip · Kamakura (transit from Kawasaki)
items.how: JR Tōkaidō Line Kawasaki → Totsuka (~25 min), change across the platform to the Yokosuka Line → Kamakura; ~35 min, ¥620 (no direct train; changing at Ōfuna or Yokohama also works, ~40–45 min)
items.notes:
08:30 Leave the hotel; ~09:10 Kamakura; Enoden to Hase (~5 min). Coastal old capital
Swap option: if Fri is wet and Sat is forecast clear, swap 20 and 21 Nov (Kamakura on Sat; Tsukiji, Hama-rikyū, Ginza and Shiseido on Fri). Trade-offs: Ginza Chūō-dōri is car-free only Sat–Sun, and Kamakura is busier on Sat. On a Sat Kamakura day, check out at 08:30, leave the bags at Mets and collect them on the way back. Opening days suit a swap: Shirasuya closes Thu only, Rengatei Sun only, Shiseido Parlour Mon only, Tsukiji is open on Fri 20 Nov

items.title: Kōtoku-in · Great Buddha (Daibutsu)
items.how:
Kōtoku-in, 4-2-28 Hase, Kamakura 〒248-0016
~7 min walk from Hase Sta (Enoden)
items.notes: Flat, easy; outdoor bronze Buddha. 08:00–17:00, ¥300

items.title: Hase-dera
items.how:
Hase-dera, 3-11-2 Hase, Kamakura 〒248-0016 (☎ 0467-22-6300)
~7 min walk from the Daibutsu
items.notes: Temple and sea views. 08:00–16:30 entry, ¥400. Leave by 11:10 for the Enoden to Koshigoe

items.title: Lunch · Shirasuya (shirasu-don specialist)
items.how: 2-10-13 Koshigoe, Kamakura; 3 min from Enoden Koshigoe Sta (Hase → Koshigoe ~15 min, ¥260, ~4 trains an hour)
items.notes: Fishing-family-run (Tabelog 3.52); shirasu-zukushi set. Nov is in season (the fishing ban is only Jan–Mar); raw shirasu only if the morning catch allows, boiled kama-age always on. Opens 11:00, closed Thu (Fri fine); arrive by 11:30 to beat the queue. Backup: Matsubara-an garden soba (Tabelog 3.67, Yuigahama)

items.title: Stroll · Komachi-dōri
items.how: Enoden Koshigoe → Kamakura, ~25 min; Komachi-dōri starts at Kamakura Sta East Exit
items.notes: Buy the Beniya 'Kurumicco' walnut caramels first (Hachimangū-mae honten 09:30–17:00, open daily; sells out). Snack crawl: Ichibanya hand-grilled senbei · Imoyoshikan purple-sweet-potato soft cream. Sit-down: Café Vivement Dimanche (Tabelog 3.66, Top 100; closed Wed and Thu, Fri fine, until 18:00)

items.title: Tsurugaoka Hachimangū
items.how: Tsurugaoka Hachimangū, 2-1-31 Yukinoshita, Kamakura; at the top of Komachi-dōri / Wakamiya-ōji
items.notes:
Main hall is 61 steps up (the Ōishidan), with no lift or slope; a side stair beside Wakamiya has 70 gentler steps with handrails. EH & BY can stay at the lower Maiden stage and Genpei Pond. Accessible toilet near the archery ground
If wet: add the Kamakura Kokuhōkan (Optional row below) before Hōkoku-ji

items.title: Optional (if wet) · Kamakura Kokuhōkan (National Treasure Museum)
items.how: Kamakura Kokuhōkan (鎌倉国宝館), 2-1-1 Yukinoshita, Kamakura (☎ 0467-22-0753); inside the Tsurugaoka Hachimangū grounds
items.notes: Rainy-day indoor stop: special exhibition on Zuisen-ji's 700 years (24 Oct–6 Dec 2026) plus Kamakura-period sculpture. 09:00–16:30 (last entry 16:00), closed Mon (Fri fine). ¥1,000 during this exhibition (the free 65+ entry is for Kamakura residents only). Accessibility not checked. Then taxi to Hōkoku-ji, arriving by ~15:00 while matcha is still served (to 15:30)

items.title: Hōkoku-ji bamboo garden + matcha
items.how: Hōkoku-ji (報国寺), 2-7-4 Jōmyōji, Kamakura; taxi ~2 km / 7–10 min from Hachimangū (est.) or Keikyū bus from Kamakura Sta East Exit stand 5 to 'Jōmyōji' + 3 min walk
items.notes: Bamboo grove ¥400, 09:00–16:00; matcha + sweet ¥600 at the Kyūkōan tea house, served until 15:30. A seated rest. Then taxi ~7 km / 20–30 min (est.; Fri late-afternoon traffic through central Kamakura and Rte 134) to Inamuragasaki for the sunset: leave by ~15:40

items.title: Sunset · Inamuragasaki (Mt Fuji over the sea)
items.how:
Inamuragasaki Park, Inamuragasaki, Kamakura; ~5 min walk from Enoden Inamuragasaki Sta
Back: Enoden Inamuragasaki → Kamakura, ~10 min
items.notes:
Sunset ~16:34. On a clear day Mt Fuji and Enoshima stand out over Sagami Bay. Low cape, short walk, benches. Then Toshimaya Hato Sablé main store (Komachi 2-11-19, 09:00–19:00, Fri fine) on the way to dinner
If wet or overcast: skip it (no Fuji); go straight to Hato Sablé and an earlier dinner

items.title: Dinner · Akimoto (Kamakura) or Santsuru (Kawasaki); then back to Kawasaki
items.how:
Akimoto: Aiza Kamakura 3F, 1-6-15 Komachi (3 min from Kamakura Sta) · Santsuru: 16-10 Ogawa-chō, Kawasaki
Back: Kamakura → Totsuka → Kawasaki, ~35 min
items.notes: Eat early in Kamakura: Akimoto (Tabelog 3.54, shirasu + Kamakura-vegetable tempura; closed Thu, Fri fine); walk in by ~18:00, L.O. 19:30. Or ride back and eat near the hotel: Santsuru (Tabelog 3.67, Top 100 Chinese, handmade gyōza; dinner only, 17:00–21:30; ☎ 044-233-1798, closed Tue; house rule one drink order pp, soft drinks fine)

items.how: Kawasaki

items.title: Tsukiji Outer Market · snack breakfast
items.how:
Keikyū Kawasaki → Higashi-Ginza (through-running onto the Toei Asakusa Line; some trains need a change at Sengakuji), ~35 min (est.), then ~8 min walk; or JR to Shimbashi + taxi ~5 min
Tsukiji Outer Market, 4-chōme Tsukiji, Chūō-ku, Tokyo
items.notes: Shops ~09:00–14:00. Sat 21 Nov is open: a secondary source lists the Nov closures as 1, 3, 8, 11, 15, 18, 22, 23, 29 Nov and no Saturday closures Sep–Dec (the official calendar PDF is an image, not read). Saturdays are busy, so go early and keep together in the narrow lanes. Snacks: Tsukiji Yamachō tamagoyaki (06:00–15:30, daily) · Kitsuneya horumon-don (06:30–13:30; long-established, queues)

items.title: Hama-rikyū Gardens + Nakajima tea house
items.how: Hama-rikyū Gardens, 1-1 Hamarikyū-teien, Chūō-ku, Tokyo; ~7 min walk from Tsukiji (Ōtemon gate)
items.notes:
Flat paths around a tidal pond; ¥300, ¥150 at 65+ (bring ID), 09:00–17:00. Matcha + wagashi at the Nakajima-no-ochaya tea house on the pond (shoes off; to 16:30; ~¥720, unverified). A seated rest before Ginza
If wet: skip it; the Ginza Mitsukoshi basement food halls or the Kabuki-za single act instead

items.title: Ginza · lunch, pedestrian zone, shopping
items.how:
Walk or taxi from Hama-rikyū (~15 min / ~5 min)
Ginza Chūō-dōri, Tokyo
items.notes: Chūō-dōri is car-free on Sat 12:00–17:00 (Oct–Mar; cancelled in bad weather). Lunch: Rengatei (Tabelog 3.68, est. 1895, birthplace of omurice; 11:15–15:00, L.O. 14:00, closed Sun; no reservations; expect a short queue at lunchtime). Rest: GINZA SIX rooftop garden (13F, free, 07:00–23:00). Café: Ginza Sembikiya fruit parlour, 5-5-1 Ginza (hours not checked; the Sembikiya Sōhonten parlour is in Nihonbashi, a different company) or Kimuraya anpan takeaway (since 1869). Coin lockers for shopping bags. Optional: Kabuki-za single-act (hitomakumi) seats, Nov programme Kanadehon Chūshingura (full-length, split 11:00 and 16:30); reserved single-act seats sold online from 12:00 JST the day before (credit card, max 4, ~¥600–2,800 per act, unverified), unreserved ones at the counter from 10:00 on the day (cash); 4th floor; no entry during Act 4 (通さん場); act times published ~1 Nov
items.action: Optional ★ Kabuki-za hitomakumi: buy online Fri 20 Nov 12:00 JST (e-tix.jp/shochiku_makumi)

items.title: Last dinner · Shiseido Parlour Ginza Honten (yōshoku, est. 1902)
items.how: Tokyo Ginza Shiseido Bldg 4–5F, 8-8-3 Ginza; 5 min walk to JR Shimbashi
items.notes: Tabelog 3.73; meat croquette + omurice à la carte ~¥3–5k (skip the full course); L.O. 20:30 fits the 21:00 departure. Closed Mon; Sat fine
items.action: ★ Reserve ~2–4 weeks ahead (Ikyu online / ☎ 03-5537-6241)
